key.description: Key value of the metadata element; normally `id` or `name`

issues.description: any Pkg.Issues generated  while building dependencies.

title:
All the dependencies of instance of the metadata to a type or another metadata element

Subtypes are expected to add actual dependency as fields. E.g. {@link UnitDeps} adds `componentUnits: Unit` field
which then allows use of `MetadataDeps.backwardDeps('componentUnits', '<my unit id>')`

@see Metadata#dependencies
name: MetadataDeps
